seed_offers.description: A flexible berry vine that can be sold raw or baked into Kelpberry Tart.
seed_offers.description_zh: 灵活好用的莓果藤，既能直接卖，也能烤成海莓挞。

seed_offers.description: A spiced leaf crop for sharper daytime specials or a dependable cash fallback.
seed_offers.description_zh: 带辛香的叶类作物，既能做更锋利的日间特餐，也能稳定换现金。

sell_entries.description: Move staple grain to nearby stalls for safe but modest cash.
sell_entries.description_zh: 把基础谷物卖给附近摊位，收益稳但不高。

sell_entries.description: Fresh herbs sell quickly, though the restaurant usually gets more from them.
sell_entries.description_zh: 新鲜香草卖得很快，但通常留给餐馆更划算。

sell_entries.description: Reliable berry cash flow when you need gold more than menu planning.
sell_entries.description_zh: 当你更缺金币而不是菜单搭配时，海莓能提供稳定现金流。

sell_entries.description: A good emergency sale, but flatbreads make better use of it.
sell_entries.description_zh: 应急出售不错，但做成薄饼通常更有价值。

sell_entries.description: A premium luminous fungus with a strong market price.
sell_entries.description_zh: 高档发光菌类，市场收购价相当可观。

sell_entries.description: Recovered salvage can always be traded for upkeep money.
sell_entries.description_zh: 回收废料随时都能换成维持运转的零花钱。
